title: Airboy Comics Vol 7 #6 July 1950 Hillman Golden Age - The Heap
descriptionText:
Airboy Comics Vol. 7 #6 (July 1950, Hillman Periodicals) -- genuine Golden Age comic, 52 pages, featuring Airboy, Tex, and The Heap. Original cover price 10 cents.

Condition/defect disclosure: this 75-year-old comic has a split along the spine and a chipped/creased corner on the back cover (see close-up photos) -- please review all photos carefully, as they show the actual copy you'll receive. Priced accordingly for a genuine vintage Golden Age piece with real, honestly disclosed wear.
